CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_driver_laps AS
SELECT 
    race_id, 
    driver_id, 
    lap, 
    position, 
    LAG(position) OVER (PARTITION BY race_id, driver_id ORDER BY lap) AS prev_position
FROM f1.main

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM temp_driver_laps A
JOIN temp_driver_laps B
    ON A.race_id = B.race_id
    AND A.lap = B.lap
WHERE A.prev_position > B.prev_position
  AND A.position < B.position;

WITH driver_laps AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position, CAST(lap_type AS VARCHAR) AS lap_type
    FROM f1.main.lap_positions
    WHERE lap <= 5
),
overtakes AS (
    SELECT
        curr_A.race_id,
        curr_A.lap,
        curr_A.driver_id AS driver_A,
        curr_B.driver_id AS driver_B,
        curr_B.lap_type AS B_lap_type
    FROM driver_laps curr_A
    JOIN driver_laps curr_B
        ON curr_A.race_id = curr_B.race_id
        AND curr_A.lap = curr_B.lap
        AND curr_A.driver_id != curr_B.driver_id
    JOIN driver_laps prev_A
        ON curr_A.race_id = prev_A.race_id
        AND curr_A.driver_id = prev_A.driver_id
        AND curr_A.lap = prev_A.lap + 1
    JOIN driver_laps prev_B
        ON curr_B.race_id = prev_B.race_id
        AND curr_B.driver_id = prev_B.driver_id
        AND curr_B.lap = prev_B.lap + 1
    WHERE prev_A.position > prev_B.position
      AND curr_A.position < curr_B.position
)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM overtakes;
